title: Economics
learning_outcomes: Explain scarcity and incentives in the context of economics.
Compare and distinguish market and nonmarket coordination in the context of economics.
Apply macroeconomic indicators in the context of economics.
Evaluate and justify decisions about distribution in the context of economics.

lessons.title: Scarcity and incentives
lessons.outcome: Explain scarcity and incentives in the context of economics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving scarcity and incentives; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to economic policy brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain scarcity and incentives from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of scarcity and incentives; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Market and nonmarket coordination
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish market and nonmarket coordination in the context of economics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving market and nonmarket coordination; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to economic policy brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain market and nonmarket coordination from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of market and nonmarket coordination; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Macroeconomic indicators
lessons.outcome: Apply macroeconomic indicators in the context of economics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving macroeconomic indicators; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to economic policy brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain macroeconomic indicators from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of macroeconomic indicators; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Distribution
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about distribution in the context of economics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving distribution; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to economic policy brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain distribution from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of distribution; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of scarcity and incentives; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of market and nonmarket coordination; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of macroeconomic indicators; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of distribution; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Historian, economist, legal or policy specialist as appropriate.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
